explanation.text: The Logic: Candlestick charts use candles to show open, high, low and close prices, with color-coded bodies that help identify and interpret trends. Bullish candles (green/white) close above the open, while bearish candles (red/black) close below the open. The Trap: Line charts plot only the closing price. Trading volume is shown separately as histograms, and moving averages are overlay indicators, not the chart type itself.
